messages:
maya: heads-up — saw another big spike in PR-gated evals this morning. dozens of PRs queued and runners all start at once, artifact service got overloaded. thinking about a small 'jitter coordinator' to spread starts. anyone else running into this?

leo: saw it monday too. queue depth went from 20->120 in a few minutes, lots of 429s from our artifact store.

samir: yea this is the thundering herd. current GH Action uses concurrency: group: ${{ github.ref }} so separate PRs don't get grouped. we need per-pr jitter or a dispatch layer to avoid simultaneous scheduling to buildkite.

jordan: rough idea: GH Action posts a lightweight intent to a coordinator svc (k8s), coordinator returns a start window [t0, t0+J]. the runner sleeps random(start_window) then triggers the heavy BK job. spreads load without blocking PR feedback.

tess: also want artifact dedupe. if two PRs run the exact same eval (same model rev + promptset + quant config) we should reuse the artifact instead of re-uploading. eval-key = sha(model)+sha(promptset)+quant+workload.

leo: example GH Action step (pseudo):
```yaml
- name: register-with-coordinator
  run: |
    resp=$(curl -sS -X POST -d '{"pr": "${{ github.event.number }}", "job": "eval", "key": "${{ matrix.eval_key }}"}' https://coordinator.internal/evals)
    start_at=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r .start)
    now=$(date +%s)
    sleep_seconds=$((start_at - now))
    if [ $sleep_seconds -gt 0 ]; then sleep $((RANDOM % sleep_seconds)); fi
```

maya: also add exponential retry + jitter on artifact upload if we get 429. simple backoff reduced a bunch of noise in logs last time. infra-bot: please log a ticket. :ticket:

infra-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-2378 coordinator svc + artifact dedupe. Assignees: @samir @leo

samir: minimal coordinator call (python pseudo):
```py
resp = requests.post(COORD_URL + '/reserve', json={
  'job_key': job_key,
  'pr': pr_number,
  'requested_window_secs': 300,
})
# resp -> {"start": 1712345678, "end": 1712345978}
```

jordan: important: keep PR gating latency sensible. proposal: fast-path smoke evals that run immediately (small shards) + full evals scheduled through jitter. that way PRs get quick feedback and heavy work is spread.

tess: metrics we should add: ['eval_start_stagger_ms', 'artifact_upload_retries', 'coord_requests_per_min', 'coord_failure_rate']. also dashboard alert if median stagger > 60s for PRs — signals coord issues.

maya: ok i'll prototype in sandbox — GH Action change in a feature branch + a tiny k8s svc. @leo can you own dedupe key generation and BK uploader change?

leo: 👍 will add dedupe logic to the uploader and a small unit test for key collisions. also will gate dedupe behind a flag so we can roll it out gradually.

eval-runner-bot: Note: nightly scheduler unaffected — coordinator applied only to PR-gated workflows unless env SKIP_JITTER=true. Will annotate builds with coordinator_id for tracing.

samir: drafting PR now with GH Action changes + unit tests for key gen. should be draft in ~30m.

maya: great, let's sync after the draft. thanks all! :rocket:
